Noel Testone · LAeq 92.4
Class 5 meets the Class 2 needed for this LAeq (Table A1).
LCpeak 141.2 dB(C) is 140 or more: Class 5 is needed (this is Class 5).

Uses the LAeq as entered; the office applies the shift adjustment, wearing time and fit in the report. Method paraphrased from AS/NZS 1269.3:2005 (Table A1, cl 6.2.2, App B). Not a sign-off.
